The platform

One trust layer.Two engines.

The Credential Management System makes every record verifiable and portable. The opportunity marketplace puts that proof to work.

How it moves

One credential.Four movements.

DigiCred connects the institution that issues proof, the person who owns it, and the organization that needs to trust it.

  1. 01IssueDigitally, from the source system
  2. 02CarryIn a wallet the person owns
  3. 03VerifyCryptographically, on sight
  4. 04AdvanceMatched to what comes next
Credential statusTrusted anywhere, instantly.
✓

Engine one — the CrMS

Credentials thatcome alive.

Most systems stop at issuing a badge. DigiCred manages the full life of a credential — from issuance to the moment it opens a door.

01

Issue

From your systems, not around them.

The Credential Management System (CrMS) turns transcripts, certificates, IDs, and licenses into verifiable credentials — issued straight from institutional workflows.
02

Carry

A wallet the holder owns.

Credentials live in a secure, noncustodial mobile wallet. No central honeypot of records — each person carries their own trusted proof.
03

Verify

Trust that takes seconds.

Employers, universities, and agencies verify authenticity instantly — no phone calls, no PDFs, no waiting on a registrar's queue.
04

Analyze

Prove the outcome happened.

Business-intelligence reporting ties credentials to progression, completion, and placement — evidence for boards, funders, and legislatures.

Engine two — the marketplace

Verified skills, matched towhat comes next.

States, employers, and universities post opportunities. Holders match on verified skills — so the platform doesn't just track outcomes. It helps create them, then proves they happened.

  • 01Jobs
  • 02Apprenticeships
  • 03Training
  • 04Transfer pathways

Verified skill→Visible opportunity

Use cases

Wherever proof matters,proof should move.

DigiCred started where credentials matter most — education — and extends to every sector where trust is the bottleneck.

The flagship — education

From enrollment toemployment.

Transcripts, certificates, diplomas, micro-credentials, and student IDs become verifiable credentials students own and carry. Registrars issue once; universities and employers trust instantly; institutions gain a live record of progression, completion, transfer, and placement.

For students Proof that's ready the moment opportunity appears.

For institutions Manual verification workflows disappear; outcome data gets stronger.

For employers & universities Trust on sight — hiring and transfer decisions in seconds.

See the education proof →

One trust layer,many doors.

Government

About DigiCred

Built on decades of software.Aimed at one bottleneck: trust.

DigiCred is redefining the way credentials are accessed and used — for the organizations that issue them and the people who earn them.

The vision

A global network of issuers, holders,and verifiers.

Education is where we started — and it's only the beginning. The same trusted rails extend to health records, professional licenses, financial portfolios, and travel documents: credentials that underpin digital transactions everywhere.

01

Credentials should come alive

Most systems stop at a badge. We build credentials people actually use — to unlock the next course, the next job, the next opportunity.

02

The holder comes first

Records belong to the people who earned them. Our noncustodial wallet makes ownership real, not rhetorical.

03

Trust must be verifiable

Cryptographic verification replaces phone calls and PDFs — so trust takes seconds, everywhere proof matters.

The team

Credential-native,enterprise-tested.

Our team brings decades of software-industry experience and deep expertise in verifiable credentials — chosen for the industries we serve, from education to aviation.

Legal

Privacy Policy

How DigiCred handles information in the DigiCred Wallet and related App services.Last updated: 02.01.2026

Thank you for using the DigiCred Credential Management System (CrMS) and the DigiCred Digital Wallet mobile application! We are committed to protecting your privacy and, for that reason, we have adopted this Privacy Policy to explain the data collection, use, and disclosure practices related to the DigiCred Wallet services (including the DigiCred Wallet mobile application, and any other tools, products, or services provided by DigiCred that link to or reference this Privacy Policy) (collectively, the “App”). The App is owned and operated by DigiCred Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“DigiCred”, “we”, “us” or “our”).

This Privacy Policy applies to your use of the App. It does not apply to information that you provide to any institutions through which you use the App (your “Institutions”). It also does not apply to information collected through the DigiCred website or our use of that information.

This Privacy Policy describes, among other things:

  • The process for setting up and accessing the App;
  • Our information collection practices with regard to the App; and
  • How you may be able to exercise choices regarding the information your Institution(s) collect from you in the process of setting up the App or receives from and / or transmits to you through the App.

1. Consent

By downloading, installing, accessing, or using the App, you consent to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please do not access or use the App. You agree that all transactions relating to the App or DigiCred are deemed to occur in the United States, where our servers are located.

2. Information Collected and Processed While Setting-Up and Using the App

When you set up, access, and/or use the App, we do not collect any information from you, including any information that can identify or reasonably be linked to an individual (“Personal Information”). Because of this, we do not use, process, or disclose any information about you with regard to your use of the App, except if you choose to use your Institution’s Apply Marketplace Portal or the DigiCred Credential Analysis tool. Please review Section 3 for more information on how we collect, use, and disclose information in relation to those features.

Your Institution may provide you with access to and/or the ability to use identification, credentials, or other documents (like your transcript) through the App. This Privacy Policy refers to those documents, collectively, as “Credentials”. The App only acts as a conduit to transmit and display these Credentials to you, and DigiCred does not have any access to or visibility of any information contained in the Credentials.

To enable you to use the App with respect to your Institution, YOUR INSTITUTION WILL REQUIRE YOU TO PROVIDE INFORMATION, which may include Personal Information, in order to confirm your identity. This process takes place entirely offline, and DIGICRED HOLDINGS INC. DOES NOT AND WILL NEVER HAVE ACCESS to any information you provide to your Institution for identity verification.

Once it has confirmed your identity, your Institution will provide you with a QR code to scan through the App, which will provide you with access to a unique instance of the App. This instance is similar to an account, but does not require you to use a username and/or password and never collected any information from or about you or your use of the App – you just need to enter a PIN number.

You may choose to prevent the App from accessing certain features of your mobile device (subject to the controls offered by your mobile device’s operating system), but this may prevent you from receiving certain features of the App.

3. Information Collected, Processed, and Disclosed If You Use Apply Marketplace Portal or Credential Analysis

Your Institution may, through the App, make the DigiCred Apply Marketplace Portal and Credential Analysis tool available to you. Your use of these functionalities is completely optional, and you may choose to use the App without using either functionality.

If you choose to use an Apply Marketplace Portal, we will not collect and/or have access to any of your Personal Information. If you elect to use an Apply Marketplace Portal, you may choose to share your Credentials, including Personal Information in your Credentials, with certain third parties, including schools, universities, employers, and other business partners of DigiCred who list opportunities in the Apply Marketplace Portal.

If you choose to use the Credential Analysis tool, we will only collect and process the types of Personal Information you choose to make available to us.

4. Your Institution’s Collection, Use, and Disclosure of Your Information; Other Disclosures of Your Information

As noted above, your Institution may collect information from you, including Personal Information, when confirming your identity in order to facilitate your use of the App. Additionally, the Credentials your Institution provides to you through the App may contain information about you, including Personal Information.

Your Institution’s collection, use, and disclosure of information is governed by the relevant polices of your Institution, and DigiCred is not responsible for those policies or the privacy or security practices of your Institution.

The App may also transmit Personal Information and non-Personal Information to Online Tool Providers. By “Online Tool Provider” we mean a licensor of software that we include in, or use with, the App, including an API or SDK, that provides a specialized function or service to us and that requires the transmission of Personal Information and/or non-Personal Information to the Online Tool Provider. Online Tool Providers may have the right to use Personal Information and non-Personal Information about you for their own business purposes. Use and disclosure of Personal Information and non-Personal Information by an Online Tool Provider is described in its privacy policy.

We may disclose your Personal Information to third parties when we believe, in good faith and in our sole discretion, that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to (a) enforce or apply the terms and conditions of the App, including investigation of potential violations thereof, (b) comply with legal or regulatory requirements or an enforceable governmental request, (c) protect the rights, property or safety of us, our users or other third parties, (d) submit insurance claims, cooperate with insurance investigations, and fulfil insurance subrogation activities, (e) prevent a crime or protect national security, or (f) detect, prevent or otherwise address fraud, security or technical issues.

Finally, we reserve the right to transfer information (including your Personal Information) to a third party in the event of a sale, merger, or transfer of all or substantially all of the assets of our company relating to the App, or in the unlikely event of a bankruptcy, liquidation, or receivership of our business. We will use commercially reasonable efforts to notify you of such transfer, for example, via email or by posting notice on our website.

5. Requests Related to Your Information

Unless you choose to use the Apply Marketplace Portal or Credential Analysis tools, we do not collect, process, or have access to any of your information, we cannot assist you in correcting inaccurate information in the Credentials or with deleting any of your information. Instead, you must contact your Institution to request any corrections in or deletion of your information.

Please be aware that if you request that the Institution providing credentials through the App to delete your information, including your Personal Information, you may not be able to continue to use the App.

6. Certain State Residents

You may be aware that there are various state data privacy laws currently in effect in the United States. We are not currently subject to any state laws providing rights in connection with Personal Information.

7. Residents of Nevada

We do not sell your Personal Information. However, you may contact us at info@DigiCred.co with questions.

8. Children

The App is not intended for users under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect Personal Information from users under 13 years of age. We do not authorize users under 13 years of age to use the App.

9. Information Security

We utilize reasonable information security measures to safeguard the App against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction. For example, we utilize Secure Socket Layer (SSL), Transport Layer Security (TLS), and/or similar decentralized encryption technology when sensitive data is transmitted over the Internet, and use firewalls to help prevent external access into our network. However, no data transmission over the Internet and no method of data storage can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. Therefore, you fully understand and agree that while we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect the App, we cannot guarantee its security.

10. Changes to this Policy

We may modify or update this Privacy Policy periodically with or without prior notice by posting the updated policy on this page. You can always check the “Last Updated” date at the top of this document to see when the Privacy Policy was last changed. If we make any material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you by reasonable means, which may be posting a notice of the changes on our website or through our mobile app prior to the changes becoming effective. We encourage you to check this Privacy Policy from time to time. IF YOU DO NOT AGREE TO CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY, YOU MUST STOP USING THE APP AFTER THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF SUCH CHANGES (WHICH IS THE “LAST UPDATED” DATE OF THIS PRIVACY POLICY).

11. Questions

To ask questions about our Privacy Policy or to lodge a complaint, contact us at:

DigiCred Holdings Inc.
Email: info@DigiCred.co
